canonical_title: Flying qualities due to operation of movable parts

versions.title_at_revision: Flying qualities due to operation of movable parts
versions.text:
Standard: Operation of movable parts (e.g., weapons bay doors, cargo doors, armament pods, refueling devices) does not result in flying qualities worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle flying qualities due to operation of movable parts as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Effects of Armament Delivery and Special Equipment paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct wind tunnel and piloted simulations and evaluations to assess the aerodynamic changes and handling qualities during the activation of movable parts for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental /conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the aerodynamic changes and handling qualities during the activation of movable parts for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
